name: supabase
stack: Next.js App Router + Supabase + TypeScript + Tailwind
description: Next.js 14+ with Supabase for database, auth, and storage. App Router, Server Components, and Tailwind.

tasks.name: Project scaffold
tasks.description: Initialise Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind, and the App Router. Install @supabase/supabase-js and @supabase/ssr. Pin all dependency versions.

tasks.name: Supabase client setup
tasks.description: Create browser client, server client (using @supabase/ssr), and middleware client following the official Supabase Next.js SSR guide. Export typed helpers for both environments.

tasks.name: Database schema
tasks.description: Write the initial SQL migration for all tables, indexes, and RLS policies defined in PROJECT.md. Enable Row Level Security on every table. Include seed data if needed.

tasks.name: TypeScript types from schema
tasks.description: Define TypeScript types that mirror the database schema. Export domain types separate from raw database row types. Include helper types for insert and update payloads.

tasks.name: Auth middleware and helpers
tasks.description: Configure the Next.js middleware to refresh Supabase sessions on every request. Export server-side auth helpers to get the current user in Server Components and Route Handlers.

tasks.name: Core data access layer
tasks.description: Implement typed query functions for all CRUD operations using the Supabase server client. Each function should handle errors and return typed results. No raw SQL outside migrations.

tasks.name: Root layout and navigation
tasks.description: Build the root layout with metadata, Tailwind global styles, and navigation. Navigation must display authenticated user state fetched from Supabase server-side.

tasks.name: Auth pages
tasks.description: Build login page with Supabase Auth UI or custom form. Implement the OAuth callback route handler. Redirect to main app after successful authentication.

tasks.name: Core feature server component
tasks.description: Build the main dashboard page as a Server Component. Fetch data using the data access layer. Protect with auth redirect if user is not authenticated.

tasks.name: Core feature client components
tasks.description: Build interactive client components for the main feature. Use Supabase realtime subscriptions where appropriate. Forms should handle loading and error states without third-party libraries.

tasks.name: File storage integration
tasks.description: Implement Supabase Storage helpers for file upload, signed URL generation, and deletion. Build a file upload component with progress state. Only include if PROJECT.md requires file uploads.

tasks.name: Deploy config
tasks.description: Write .env.example with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, and any other required vars. Document Supabase project setup and migration steps in README.
